body.text: From {param:town}, where I sit, and where I can tell you rather more than I can about anywhere else.
{param:governor} has set himself on {param:intent}, and speaks of you {param:regard}.
Your instructions have been refused here {param:refused} times since you took the desk. I doubt anyone else has told you that number, and I doubt he would recognise it if you put it to him.
I dine there on Thursdays. It is not an imposition; the cellar is better than mine.
